findings.title: Reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is not joined before asserting or finishing the test
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti()`, the background thread started on line 139 is never joined after `deletedAll.set(true)` on line 155. If the background thread is still executing an in-flight `groups(...)` request when the main thread reaches `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` on line 157, any exception thrown by that final request will be added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already passed. In addition, the still-running thread can continue executing into subsequent tests or realm cleanup. Store the `Thread` reference and call `thread.join()` after `deletedAll.set(true)` and before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.

findings.title: Paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference null modelSupplier.get() on concurrent deletion
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` was updated on lines 274-275 to guard against `modelSupplier.get()` returning `null` when the underlying group has been concurrently removed from the database, but the three `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads on lines 256, 262, and 268 still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly without a null check. If a cached group is concurrently deleted while any of these methods is called, `modelSupplier.get()` returns `null` and a `NullPointerException` is thrown.
